6. Her supplication for her sinful Shia and Shia of her progeny
introduction:
Her supplication for her sinful Shia and Shia of her progeny

It is narrated from Asma binte Umais that she said: I saw her seated facing the Qibla during her illness, raising her hands to the heavens and saying:

verses.arabic: اِلٰهِیْ وَ سَیِّدِیْ اَسْاَلُكَ بِالَّذِیْنَ اصْطَفَیْتَهُمْ، وَ بِبُكَاءِ وُلْدِیْ فِیْ مُفَارَقَتِیْ: اَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِعُصَاۃِ شِیْعَتِیْ وَ شِیْعَۃِ ذُرِّیَّتِیْ۔
